scope: Local renderer sprint. Headed Chromium on Apple M5 Max/128 GB, ANGLE Metal. In-page fixture transport; no native backend or IPC. Short diagnostic protocols, not M1 or WKWebView certification.

notes: Timing ran serially, without concurrent builds, tests, or other browser workloads.
No resource updates still includes metric replies while scrolling.
Sparse baseline capture windows were longer; one throttled baseline missed part of the path. Do not claim matched live-update total-work speedups.
Repeated startup ABBA used six fresh contexts per side. The initial 8.7% readiness difference shrank to 2%; script work fell 6.3%. Not proof of a startup speedup.
Requested larger overscan increases rows and healthy target demand. Observation counts are not upstream network-request counts.
Live heap depends on GC timing. Retained-memory comparison explicitly forces full GC.
DOM coverage and selected screenshots do not certify every compositor frame.

The fixture keeps initial samples per observation. A viewport retarget can deliver unchanged values with newer timestamps. This metadata-heavy workload stayed identical across before/after; it is not a claim about a stable metrics-server scrape clock.

Follow-up layout, compositor, scalar memoization, CSS registration and DOM shell reuse experiments failed screening and were not retained. Earlier recordings use harness be3dfbc9b7ec; the shell experiment uses reviewed harness a64bbc0af097. Each comparison stays within its matching harness cohort.

keptChanges: Opt-in immutable-row text-sort reuse in shared base-ui; current rows and native fallback preserved.
One metric inspection tooltip root per DataTable; standalone inspection unchanged.
Changing admitted-record context wraps the active row menu, not the virtual row tree.
Keyboard-reachable namespace copy, native filter buttons, safe filter values, and clipboard-error feedback.
